from.place: Detailed form, Step 3: a finitely generated subsheaf embeds into a finite product of constant pushforwards

title: Finite-generation embedding into constant pushforwards
statement: Let T be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] and F a locally constant sheaf of abelian groups [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] on T. If F is generated as a sheaf by finitely many sections on quasi-compact open subsets, then there exist closed subsets C_b of T (hence locally closed subsets in the sense of [def-weil-locally-closed-subset]), their continuous inclusion maps i_b:C_b to T, and abelian groups M_b, together with a monomorphism of sheaves F to the finite product of the pushforwards (i_b)_* underline{M_b}, where direct image along each continuous inclusion is as in [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] and underline{M_b} is the constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. The construction is required to use the finitely many germs and their equalizer loci; no finiteness of the groups M_b is assumed.
